title: linear pullback factorization through a quotient-system isomorphism
statement: Given a quotient-system isomorphism whose components equal finite pullback, there are linear maps whose components satisfy both displayed formulas, as stated in the Lean declaration.

source.place: Tag 02OD, finite-level identifications; Tags 089W, 01F7 and 01FB (read at https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/02OD, /089W and /01FB)

proof.text: For each n compose the underlying linear map of b.hom.app (op n) with that of C.map (formalModuleQuotientπ J (n + 1) F'). Both are morphisms in ModuleCat over the stalk ring. LinearMap.comp constructs the required linear map. Its first component formula is definitional, and its second component formula is exactly the supplied hypothesis on b. No construction of b or geometric comparison theorem is used.

proof_origin.place: Elementary linear-map composition for the conditional factorization statement, after the finite-level identifications of Tag 02OD; written by C1.

lean.statement: theorem formalFunctions_finite_quotient_iso_r {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) [IsProper f] [IsLocallyNoetherian Y] (F : X.Modules) (hF : RingedSpace.IsCoherent X.toRingedSpace F) (y : Y) (p : ℕ) : let X' := pullback (Y.fromSpecStalk y) f let f' := pullback.fst (Y.fromSpecStalk y) f let F' := (Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback (pullback.snd (Y.fromSpecStalk y) f)).obj F let J := (Scheme.IdealSheafData.ofIdealTop ((maximalIdeal (Y.presheaf.stalk y)).map (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of (Y.presheaf.stalk y))).inv.hom)).comap f' let C := RingedSpace.moduleCohomology X'.toRingedSpace p ⋙ ModuleCat.restrictScalars ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of (Y.presheaf.stalk y))).inv ≫ f'.appTop).hom ∀ (b : formalCompletionSystem J F' ⋙ C ≅ formalFibreCohomologySystem f y F p ⋙ ModuleCat.restrictScalars (algebraMap (Y.presheaf.stalk y) (AdicCompletion (maximalIdeal (Y.presheaf.stalk y)) (Y.presheaf.stalk y)))), (∀ (n : ℕ) (z : formalFunctionsLocalCohomology f y F p), (b.hom.app (op n)) ((C.map (formalModuleQuotientπ J (n + 1) F')) z) = formalFunctionsFinitePullback f y F p n z) → ∃ r : ∀ n : ℕ, formalFunctionsLocalCohomology f y F p →ₗ[Y.presheaf.stalk y] formalFibreCohomologyLocal f y F p n, (∀ (n : ℕ) (z : formalFunctionsLocalCohomology f y F p), r n z = (b.hom.app (op n)) ((C.map (formalModuleQuotientπ J (n + 1) F')) z)) ∧ ∀ (n : ℕ) (z : formalFunctionsLocalCohomology f y F p), r n z = formalFunctionsFinitePullback f y F p n z
